detail.longDescription:
My most infuriating issue in programming is undefined, unlimited scope of the features. At least 7 times this resulted in me making a feature for a month/2 instead of the week.
I just can't do things simple or fast as required, I try to think through and build correctly from the beginning.
That just doesn't work in indie.
While I am developing yet another methodology to take control of myself, share your experience in scope cutting and meeting deadlines!
#planning #programming #indiedev

[ ] I do work slowly
[ ] I do work quickly
[ ] I do work smart
[ ] I do work simple
